public.title: Schema Validator III
public.description: input {schema,value}; schemas recursively use primitive type string/boolean/integer, object {fields}, or array {items}; any schema may mark optional:true (missing object fields then pass). Return invalid leaf paths in schema-field and array-index order, starting at $. Type mismatch at a container reports only that container path. Extra object fields are ignored; null is never missing. At most 6 schema levels and 40 value leaves. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Recursively validate containers, extending paths only when container types match. O(visited schema/value pairs times depth) time and path/output space. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
